purpose: Repair one structured-output serialization failure in ProminenceAssessment.
normalization_rule: Preserve an already-valid S# ID unchanged. Otherwise, replace an item only when its trimmed value exactly equals one of the supplied rendered source lines '<valid S#>: <exact span text>'. Any other malformed/unknown value is left unchanged and is rejected by the original frozen validator.
persisted_prepatch_score_rationale: A row persisted before this patch necessarily passed the original strict prominence validator, so it could not have used this repair path.
